rows.grounds: numeral indicating a set of eight
conjunction adding to the preceding list
fused sandhi form: siddhisaṃprāptiḥ + mūlakaulam; compound expressing attainment of powers as the root Kaula

items.question: What additional attainment constitutes the root Kaula, O fair-faced one?
premises: Eight attainments are enumerated in this context.
The attainment of powers is identified as the root Kaula.
items.inference: The attainment of powers, counted as eight, is declared to be the root Kaula.
uncertainties: The exact scope of the eight powers is not specified within this verse alone.
items.plain_english: And the attainment of the eight powers is the root Kaula, O fair-faced one.
